fields.name: steel_grade
fields.rationale: The steel grade provides information about the mechanical properties and chemical composition of the steel, which is crucial for determining its suitability for specific applications.

fields.name: coating_weight
fields.rationale: The coating weight is important for understanding the corrosion resistance of the steel product, especially in environments where it may be exposed to moisture or chemicals.
evidence: zinc coating (100 g/m2 as minimum weight)

fields.name: profile_shape
fields.rationale: The shape of the steel profile (U, C, etc.) is critical for its structural application, influencing how it can be used in construction projects.
evidence: profiles that, on the floor and ceiling, block the foot and head of the vertical studs of the wall warps
profiles that constitute the vertical structures of the wall frames
profiles used to form the frame for a suspended ceiling system
inference_basis: U tracks Guide, C studs Montanti, C channels Profili
